start_here: Say to your AI: "Send a text message, to one number or a list, through the text provider I connected", with {"to":"+15550100101","provider":"twilio-sms","from":"+15550100100","account_sid":"ACsample00000000000000000000000000","text":"Hello there"}. It runs tool:send-a-text and answers {"provider":"twilio-sms","sent":[{"recipient":"+15550100101","messageId":"SMsample00000000000000000000000000"}],"said":"Sent to 1 of 1 through Twilio text message."}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and answers, and keeps no row.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Send a text message, to one number or a list, through the text provider I connected", and give it provider; from; account_sid.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:send-a-text and its input (the worked example shows one).

3. Read what comes back: Give recipients (phone numbers with country code; to for one), provider (the id of the text provider row in read-data/message-providers.json that the person's text connection is), the settings that row asks for (for twilio-sms: from, a number on the account, and account_sid, the account's id) and text (or subject when there is no text).
